cross_architecture.note: GCN-only flags are derived WITHOUT the CNN auditor, so their enrichment inside the CNN top-decile-loss stratum is a cross-architecture, non-circular check: do images one architecture suspects also give the other architecture trouble out-of-fold? The flagged-vs-unflagged NLL gap for CNN flags is partly by construction and is reported only as a sanity check, not as evidence.
